environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in a public subnet. The NLB performs TCP passthrough on port 443 with TLS termination at the instance. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No application-layer filtering or inspection is configured between the client and the Flask application. The SQLite database file is on an attached EBS volume at /data/app.db.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (TCP passthrough, no content inspection)
config.tls: terminated at EC2 instance via nginx reverse proxy
